## About
Len's Auto Body is a collision repair shop on Cottman Ave in Philadelphia. Our goal is simple: restore your vehicle's appearance and performance to pre-accident condition.
Len owns the shop and takes an active role in running it every day. He deals with the insurance companies, the vendors and, most importantly, you. He has built a family environment here, the kind of place where people enjoy coming to work.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 58 reviews, and we'd be glad to take a look at your car.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body work after an accident, with the aim of bringing your car back to pre-accident condition.
- Paint and color matching: Paint work matched to your car's original color.
- Restoration and custom work: Restoration and custom body work for drivers who want their car to look its best.
- Rental cars: Rental cars at a discounted rate through Enterprise Rent A Car while your car is in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. Len acts as the go-between for the insurance companies, the public and our customers, so you have someone handling that side of the repair.

Q: How do I get a rental while my car is being fixed?
A: We have an arrangement with Enterprise Rent-A-Car on Roosevelt Boulevard. A reviewer noted that Enterprise will pick you up and drive you to their rental facility.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
